Data is abundant, but broken. As the specialist workforce retires out, risk surfaces before anyone has the capacity to see it coming.

For every project, TRAIL builds a digital site ontology that ties each feature, a tailings cell, a foundation, a corridor segment, to its instruments, imagery, design basis, and history. Context, not just documents.
Humans review the insights and the citations behind them to approve findings and understand failure modes.
Built For Complex Projects
KorrAI has significantly enhanced how Zurich E&S evaluates properties for subsidence risk.
By providing high-resolution, property-level data, they’ve supported us in improving risk assessment and identifying new business opportunities.
They offer a mature, solution-driven approach that aligns well with our business needs. Their innovative technology and attentive engagement have made them as a valuable collaborator.

Traditional geotechnical studies rely on few monitoring points and point-in-time inspections, leaving you blind to everything in between. Risk indicators remain scattered in reports and data that stay across teams and channels. Stitching the correlations to reveal risky site behavior across full footprint is time-consuming and judgement based.

KorrAI solved the problem for us. They unify site intelligence right from phase-1 site studies and through construction monitoring to operations. Their platform is conveniently scalable and supports critical risk management decisions.

My experience working with KorrAI has been outstanding. Their team consistently goes above and beyond, providing expert support and tailoring solutions to meet our specific goals related to tracking ground deformation in waste rock piles to monitoring natural landslides.

On the technology front, they continue to iterate on novel AI algorithms for rapid processing and increased reliability. What they are doing today is the next obvious step for the remote-sensing commercial industry.
Chief Growth Officer - Proqio, Encardio Rite Group
KorrAI’s technology prowess is very evident from their unique approach using ground-based IoT sensors to increase reliability of InSAR and deliver more robust reporting.
Whether it’s technical assistance or collaborative partnership, the team is always available and proactive.
KorrAI’s product is an integral part of our Risk Reduction Monitoring offerings for the mining sector.

It’s refreshing to see proactivity in making recommendations and transparency in sharing limitations of a site and dataset.
Given their depth of knowledge and professionalism, we truly value their perspective and the results delivered.

We have seen a positive impact on revenue growth at Zurich E&S
